description:
The Reactor is intended to be the most race-oriented road frame in the No. 22 lineup. With an emphasis on stiffness, responsive handling and light weight, the Reactor is the perfect titanium stage race tool. The Reactor is a modern rim-brake race bike — caliper brakes, quick-release wheels, and no compromises. (Prefer discs? Meet the Aurora.)

When developing the Reactor, we set out to increase the already high levels of drivetrain stiffness offered by our versatile Great Divide road bike. To achieve this, the Reactor features an oversized down tube and chain stays, both of which are among the largest offered on a titanium frame. The Reactor’s chain stays are a full 25.4mm in diameter, ovalized to 30mm at the bottom bracket for increased stiffness. When coupled with the bike’s oversized head tube and size-specific butting and tubing sizes, the result is a bike that responds crisply and immediately to hard efforts.

FULLY BUTTED TUBE SET TO SHAVE GRAMS AND TUNE THE RIDE QUALITY

CUSTOM MACHINED TITANIUM HEAD TUBES AND HEAD SETS FOR PRECISE HANDLING AND A SEAMLESS LOOK

CUSTOM MACHINED TITANIUM HEADSETS COMPLETE WITH ENDURO STAINLESS BEARINGS ARE NOW A STANDARD OFFERING ON ALL FRAMESETS.

CUSTOM FILAMENT WOUND MULTI-LAYERED CARBON SEAT MAST

PROPRIETARY 3D SINTERED GRADE 5 SEAMLESS TITANIUM DROP-OUTS

LIGHTWEIGHT NO. 6 COMPOSITES CARBON FORK INCREASES TIRE CLEARANCE WHILE MAINTAINING PERFORMANCE ORIENTED GEOMETRY

T47 BOTTOM BRACKET FOR MAXIMUM STIFFNESS AND A TIME-TESTED THREADED INTERFACE

CUSTOM MACHINED BRAKE BRIDGE

MASSIVE 25MM CHAINSTAYS FOR INCREASED STIFFNESS AND POWER TRANSFER

3D SINTERED GRADE 5 SEAT MAST TOPPER IN MULTIPLE OFFSETS
